source_text.ISS-0917:
id: ISS-0917
title: "Catalog SERVICE_TASK cannot execute: ServiceTaskDispatcher.catalog_lookup_stub/2 is an unconditional {:error,:not_registered}; POST /tasks/:id/complete returns 500 when the next node is a catalog-only SERVICE_TASK"
discovered_by: RELEASE-VALIDATOR
discovered_in_run: WF02-REQ432-20260930 (filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-09-30T20:50:51Z"
severity: MAJOR
owner: "ELIXIR-DEV"
description: >
  Found by WF02-REQ432-20260930 (REQ-432 live pipeline run,
  test/reports/report-20260930-WF02-REQ432-20260930.yaml; step-02b-rework1-frontend-
  dev.json). A process whose SERVICE_TASK references a service_id (catalog_entry pin) cannot
  ever execute: Letflow.Engine.ServiceTaskDispatcher.catalog_lookup_stub/2
  (lib/letflow/engine/service_task_dispatcher.ex ~411-416) returns {:error,:not_registered}
  unconditionally, so activation renders an empty URL. Measured live: completing the
  preceding human task hops synchronously into the SERVICE_TASK, the engine persists only
  EXECUTION_ERROR (affected node n3, error_type service_task_url_rendered_empty, no
  TASK_COMPLETED for the completed task) and POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/complete answers HTTP
  500 (probably needs a non-500 mapping for {:instance_execution_error,_,_} in
  lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex). Independent of service retirement. Consequence: scenario
  platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change EO-001/EO-004 'the in-flight step completes
  without error' cannot be met on success; REQ-432's pipeline spec accepts the measured
  outcome (B) as a documented limitation. Needed: resolve service_id through the instance's
  PINNED service_catalog version (Letflow.Engine.PinResolver / ServiceCatalog lookup) in the
  dispatcher, then tighten the REQ-432 spec step 03 to require success. SCOPE GAP already
  noted in design docs lib/letflow/design/req373-service-catalog-version-lifecycle.md and
  lib/letflow/design/req432-rebind-pins-publish-retire-ui.md (M5). Owner ELIXIR-DEV (via
  CODE-DESIGNER). Severity MAJOR.
  NOTE (added by ORCH at close-out of the cancelled duplicate run WF02-REQ432-20260930): the
  REQ-432 implementation that actually landed on main is PR #2055 (5d7ca7bf), not this run's
  branch. Its spec (web/tests/e2e/pipelines/platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change
  .pipeline.e2e.spec.ts, header 'Scope note (deliberately not exercised): SERVICE_TASK dispatch')
  never drives a token onto the SERVICE_TASK node, so on main the scenario's 'the in-flight step
  completes without error' (EO-001/EO-004 step 3) is unverified; the evidence of this stub's effect
  is the duplicate run's live finding (archived on remote branch feature/WF02-REQ432-20260930,
  handoffs/WF02-REQ432-20260930/step-02b-rework1-frontend-dev.json and step-05-release-validator.json).
source_reports:
  - handoffs/WF02-REQ432-20260930/step-05-release-validator.json
  - test/reports/report-20260930-WF02-REQ432-20260930.yaml
affected_files:
  - lib/letflow/engine/service_task_dispatcher.ex
  - lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex
queue_ref: Q-907  # queue allocated issue_ref ISS-0907, which collides with an existing local file; local filename kept as ISS-0917 (next free on origin/main) and GH-2057 retitled to match
github_ref: GH-2057
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 2b RE-VALIDATION (attempt 2 of the design gate). Your predecessor's FAIL verdict is in handoffs/WF03-ISS0917-20261001/step-02b-code-design-validator.json (5 blocking issues + non-blocking items + OQ rulings); CODE-DESIGNER reworked lib/letflow/design/iss0917-catalog-service-task-pinned-dispatch.md (rework summary in handoffs/WF03-ISS0917-20261001/step-02-code-designer.json result.summary). Independently re-verify each of the 5 blocking issues is actually fixed in the file (read the file, do not trust the summary), that the OQ rulings were applied as ruled, that the rework introduced no NEW problem (re-check any new facts it cites against code: e.g. jwtSubject helper and the shipment-attach-delivery-note idiom exist; SERVICE_TASK_MOCK_TRAP_PATH design coherence; section 3.3a/T10/T11; tasks.ex line refs), and that no implementation code is in the doc and no deferral language remains. Also run a final completeness pass: could a weak model implement ELIXIR-DEV, TEST-DESIGNER and the FRONTEND e2e step from this doc without guessing? Verdict PASS/FAIL with numbered blocking issues. Complete your handoff per HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md section 3. Modify only your handoff; do not commit.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 5 prior blocking issues verified fixed or re-raised
No file other than the handoff modified

result.summary:
VERDICT: PASS. All 5 prior blocking issues verified FIXED by reading the file; no new blocking issue.

PRIOR BLOCKERS: (1) e2e trap URL fixed (sec 6.4 item 2): v1=base+'/shared-connection/v1' (default https://httpbin.org/anything); v2 trap=new URL(base).origin + SERVICE_TASK_MOCK_TRAP_PATH (default /status/503); non-httpbin mock handled via trap-path override or E2E_SKIP_SERVICE_TASK_POLL=1; coherent with ISS-0930 precedent (default confirmed in iss0930 design line ~148). (2) e2e completing identity prescribed concretely (item 6): jwtSubject imported from ../pipeline (exists, web/tests/e2e/pipeline.ts:75, exported), adminSub in state, HUMAN_TASK role/assignee_ref=sub, assignee_type 'USER' uppercase; verified against code: TaskActivation stores assignee_type verbatim, Letflow.Tasks.apply_completion_authz clauses are nil/USER/GROUP/ROLE only, so the lowercase fixture (spec line 204) would fail. Shipment spec idiom (role=user sub) exists; design correctly differs by using uppercase USER. (3) R1/R2 now use ROLE/approver idiom with insert_user!/insert_group!/insert_group_member!/insert_role! - helpers exist at test/letflow/routers/tasks_test.exs:113,128,136,150 and 'REQ-085 AC1' describe at 1298. (4) OQ-6 KEEP; service_task_test.exs:279 listed as UNCHANGED in 4.2. (5) Deferral language gone: env var E2E_SKIP_SERVICE_TASK_POLL=1 named with polarity, OQ-7 decided, OQ-4/OQ-8 are stated facts (pin_rebind.ex:340 lock_projection_nowait confirmed; unique index in migration 20260921000004 confirmed), D7 says 'Confirmed'. grep for TBD/TODO/verify/ORCH confirms: none (only 'deferred'/'defer' used in negated rationale).

NEW FACTS RE-CHECKED: call-site lines 563/2481/2702/3106/3518 and tenant_id bindings at 2477/2698/3102 are exact; tasks.ex 403 clauses at 378-388 and catch-all after (clause ~402, comment block lists {:instance_execution_error,_,_} as design says); handle_list route params (status PENDING, instance_id) match item 3; instances routes /:id and /:id/history exist; start_service_task_dispatcher false only in config/test.exs:56; tenant_id_for_schema_name returns {:error,:invalid_schema_name} (3.3a/T11 coherent); section 3.3a/T10/T11 consistent with 3.4-3.6. No fenced code blocks in doc; no implementation code. Design file is already committed (git status shows only unrelated untracked workspace file); no file modified by this step except this handoff.

COMPLETENESS PASS: ELIXIR-DEV (signatures, pipeline order, snapshot keys, error tuples per site, file list), TEST-DESIGNER (T1-T11, resolver matrix, R1-R3, mutants, authz setup) and FRONTEND-DEV (state addition, env vars, step 04b assertions, fixture change, skip annotation) can implement without guessing.

NON-BLOCKING (fix opportunistically, e.g. DOC-UPDATER/ELIXIR-DEV; do not re-gate): (a) sec 6.4 item 6 cites 'Tasks.apply_completion_authz/3 (routers/tasks.ex:540-565)' - actually Letflow.Tasks in lib/letflow/tasks.ex:540-565 (clauses verified there). (b) sec 12 retains a vestigial empty table header '| ID | Question | Default if unanswered |' above the status table; cosmetic. (c) sec 11 says 'T1-T9' though T10/T11 exist. (d) completion-hop empty_url clause is at engine.ex:3549 not ~3545 ('near' wording, function-anchored).
